title: Husk Sand Drop
description: Husks have a chance to drop sand on death — 26.7% for 1, 13.8% for 2, and 6.7% for 3–4 sand.
body:
## Husk Sand Drop

A simple Minecraft Forge mod for version 1.20.1 that makes Husks drop sand upon death.

## Drop Chances

| Amount | Chance |
|--------|--------|
| 1 sand | 26.7% |
| 2 sand | 13.8% |
| 3–4 sand | 6.7% |

Each roll is independent, so it is possible to receive multiple drops in a single kill.

## Why this mod?

Husks are desert creatures — it makes sense that they would drop sand. 
This mod adds a small but satisfying reward for hunting Husks in desert biomes.

## Requirements

- Minecraft 1.20.1
- Forge 47.3.0 or higher
